# Ninety-Eight Entertainment

> A creative and strategic firm in Delhi NCR, founded 1 January 2020 by Harsh Arya, that works as a business partner, not a vendor. Two verticals: Talent & Branding (personal branding and talent management — exclusive representation for athletes, creators and founders) and Marketing (seven instruments: branding, PR & media, creators/influencer marketing, paid & search, social, production, events). 70+ brands, 35 documented cases, an exclusive contract with Test cricketer Ishant Sharma, three restaurant awards for one client group in 2023. Every number on the site traces to a case; where there is no case, the page says so. Reach is reported as combined follower reach, never impressions.

Contact: contact@ninety-eight.in · WhatsApp +91 97111 84674 · Instagram @98.entertainment

## Case studies

- [Andrea's Eatery](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/andreas/): Saket. Revamped launch. Creator-led discovery — without buying a single ad.
- [Arista Vault](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/arista-vault/): A luggage-tech founder we partnered with on equity terms instead of fees — because we knew the deck was Shark-Tank-bound.
- [Bayroute](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/bayroute/): A new Levantine kitchen in Delhi's saturated fine-dining grid — diners had heard the name, none had tasted the room.
- [Borges India](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/borges/): Cook For Your Loved Ones — a Spanish heritage brand told in the language of Indian home kitchens.
- [Daryaganj](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/daryaganj/): "Inventors of butter chicken & dal makhani" — a heritage Indian house with the strongest origin claim in Indian-restaurant marketing.
- [Deja Brew](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/dejabrew/): Greater Kailash 2 has a café on every corner. Deja Brew needed to own a specific evening — sufi, sheesha, soft-lit social — not the daytime brunch grid.
- [Farzi Cafe](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/farzi-cafe/): 98's highest-reach concentrated activation. 20 creators delivering 6.49M combined reach for Farzi Cafe — Massive Restaurants' contemporary Indian concept. Anchored on Amar Sirohi (@foodie_incarnate, 2.35M public figure), Syma Verma (766K), Saanya Khatter (532K), Mehak Dhawan (338K), Harteerath Singh (297K). Founder Zorawar Kalra (Massive Restaurants) in the supporting roster — a rare founder presence.
- [Fast & Up](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/fast-up/): Sixth-anniversary milestone event for a health-and-wellness brand — a curated celebration that married brand essence with twenty creator voices.
- [Flaunt by Duty Free](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/flaunt/): 6 creators delivering 1.70M reach for Flaunt by Duty Free — a Noida launch carnival stacking five sister-brands (Duty Free, Vāyubar, Oscar, Float, Stir It Up). 4 verified handles, 18 story frames. Anchored on Syma Verma (766K verified reel creator), Asmita Arora (467K verified public figure), Akanksha Upneja (206K verified blogger), and verified couple-duo @thestreetstalkers (154K).
- [Happydent · Sparkling Smile](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/happy-dent/): A six-week influencer-driven campaign for a chewing-gum brand, built around freshness, confidence, and the smile that follows.
- [Hard Rock Cafe](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/hard-rock/): A live-music night-out at Hard Rock Cafe New Delhi — band on stage, fishbowl cocktails, memorabilia walls, classic American bar food.
- [Ishant Sharma](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/ishant/): The personal-brand case. We didn't manage talent. We ran a brand.
- [Khubani](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/khubani/): Afternoon "spa lunch" — manicures while you eat. Plus a Levantine night-vibe sister concept, Habibi by Khubani.
- [Limitless](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/limitless/): A multi-outlet Delhi lounge brand. Two locations on the calendar — one creator playbook running across both.
- [Local](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/local/): Noida is rarely the venue side of a creator campaign — most rosters skew Delhi or Gurugram. Local needed two creators willing to travel + make Noida feel like a destination.
- [Meta Creator Enablement Programme](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/meta-creator/): A six-month programme bringing thirty-plus YouTube creators onto Facebook's video surface — directly enriching the platform's library.
- [Monet](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/monet/): Monet is a dessert-led Italian kitchen — meaning the plating is the marketing. Most diners decide before they read the menu.
- [Nao by Berco’s](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/nao/): Nao is a Berco's spinoff entering the modern pan-Asian space. The parent brand has 30+ years of Indo-Chinese equity — we needed to launch Nao as its own concept, not a Berco's extension.
- [One8 Commune](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/one8-commune/): Virat Kohli's restaurant brand — celebrity-anchored premium dining, run as a creator-roster magnet.
- [Ophelia](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/ophelia/): A modern-European brunch room in Delhi where the menu reads like an editorial — blue tufted velvet, peach walls, marigolds on the pasta.
- [Poetry](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/poetry/): Poetry sits in the upscale all-day-café space where the room wins on architecture, not virality. The brand had run on word-of-mouth — we needed to build a feed presence without breaking the room's quiet.
- [RIZQ](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/rizq/): A new Levantine + Italian fusion concept walking into a market that already had a clear Italian leader and three credible Levantine restaurants.
- [Rooh](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/rooh/): Premium fine-dining at Ambawatta One — sufi nights, chef pop-ups, tasting-menu storytelling.
- [iSKATE by Roseate](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/roseate/): An indoor ice rink anchored at a Roseate Hotels property — a luxury-hotel amenity venue that turns "Delhi summer" into "skate season."
- [Sky Lantern](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/sky-lantern/): 22 creators across 70 story frames at Sky Lantern — Panchsheel Park courtyard café. Combined reach 3.52M (13 verified handles). Anchored on Saanya Khatter (533K), Deeksha (423K), Prerna Massey (419K verified), Bhavya Monga Arya (389K verified). Repositioned a winter Sunday luncheon as a feed-event the city kept living off.
- [Slay Coffee](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/slay-coffee/): Cup-shot UGC, partner co-packs, and a "food court in an app" — built with creators who screenshot recipes and order takeaway.
- [Slique](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/slique/): Slique runs a Friday-night-onwards positioning — the room only converts after dark. We needed a creator stack that would show up at SLIQUE in the same kind of dressed-for-it mode their audience would.
- [Tablespoon (TBSP)](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/tablespoon/): 17 creators delivering 3.47M combined reach for TableSpoon — a Yum Yum Cha umbrella brand operating Delhi multi-cuisine. 8 verified handles, 64 story frames. Anchored on Varun Verma (590K verified digital creator), Shreya Chadda (480K), Toshali Paliwal (360K verified), Harteerath Singh (297K verified), Saaniya Khanna (264K verified).
- [The Great Indian Sneaker Fest](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/tgisf/): India's biggest sneaker fest — a streetwear-and-culture festival anchored on forty-plus creators, one stage, one weekend.
- [The Weekend](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/the-weekend/): A constellation creator launch for The Weekend Wine & More — a Moroccan-inspired fine-dining and wine destination on the upper deck of Gardens Galleria Mall, Noida. Twenty creator handles activated, seventeen active across four audience verticals, combined reach 2.55M. One venue, one weekend, one cultural arrival.
- [Tickled Pink](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/tickled-pink/): A Saket destination room where the dinner is the photoshoot — pink, polka-dot, Wonderland-coded, designed to be photographed.
- [Unacademy](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/unacademy/): Importing YouTube's best educators onto Unacademy's live-class platform — turning open-internet teachers into platform talent.
- [Yum Yum Cha Group](https://www.ninety-eight.in/cases/yyc-group/): Three brands. One operating playbook. Two national awards in a single year.

## Method

- [How we count a creator campaign](https://www.ninety-eight.in/blog/how-we-count.html): creators activated, verified handles, story frames, combined follower reach; rosters in three tiers counted apart.
